next.reason: 1985 makes the relative FILE STATUS clause the sequential one, its content per I-O Status. 2023 writes one FILE STATUS clause (12.4.5.8) into the relative and sequential formats (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR9, SR11), and §2023:12.4.5.8.4 GR1 'A list of the possible I-O status values is contained in 9.1.13'. The clause's syntax rules are the sequential FILE STATUS record's, not part of this one.
